findings.evidence: <div class="icon-delete" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Delete item" id="s3-customcontrol">
findings.violation: The custom button control has tabindex but no keyboard event handlers, making it inaccessible to keyboard users who cannot activate the button.
findings.fix: Add JavaScript event listeners for keyboard interaction (e.g., handle Enter and Space keys) or use a native <button> element instead.

findings.location: Line 44, img element inside custom button
findings.violation: The icon has an empty alt text but serves a functional purpose (delete button). Screen reader users cannot understand what action this icon performs.
findings.fix: Either add descriptive alt text to the image (alt="Delete") or rely on the parent's aria-label and use alt="" only if the image is purely decorative within a labeled control.

findings.violation: The link text "click here" is generic and not descriptive. Screen reader users navigating by links cannot understand the destination without surrounding context.
findings.fix: Use descriptive link text that indicates the destination, such as view fare adjustment history.

findings.evidence: <label for="phone" id="s3-form-phone-label">Phone number (required)</label> and <input id="phone" type="tel">
findings.violation: The label text says the field is required, but the input element lacks the required attribute, creating a mismatch between label text and input semantics.
findings.fix: Add the required attribute to the input: <input id="phone" type="tel" required>.
